research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: RoboTire is engaged in developing systems for automated vehicle wheel removal and replacement, as described in 'Automated removal and replacement of vehicle wheels and tires,' which integrates robotic apparatus and computer-controlled lifts. Research also includes computer vision-based methods for identifying vehicle lifting points, as detailed in 'Low rise vehicle lift and method of operation,' and machine learning techniques for accurately locating lug nut centers, as in 'Locating a center point of a lug nut for an automated vehicle wheel removal.'
